title: Clx – Compile Lua to Native Executables Through C++20
claim: Show HN: Clx – Compile Lua to Native Executables Through C++20
why_good: Compiles Lua to native executables via C++20 — a neat toolchain that lets Lua ship as fast standalone binaries.
value: Dev tools like this are usually free/open; monetization is thin unless it anchors a commercial runtime.
risk: Niche compiler tooling; small audience and hard to build a business around a language transpiler.
